title: datasources: a runtime datasource named "drivers" is accepted, but GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers answers the driver catalog, so its detail read is unreachable
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZZ5q3itDsK1WDVLyQ

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: HTTP，`POST /api/v1/datasources` + `GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers`，同一启动实测两次）
业务理由: 管理员给数据源起名 `drivers`（一个自然的名字）时创建成功，但之后数据源编辑表单的详情读永远拿到的是驱动目录，表单打不开或显示错的数据，管理员看不出原因；`default` 已被保留拒绝，同类的路由字面段却没有。
动手的读者: 拥有 `packages/services/service-datasource` 的车道：`assertValidName` 拒绝注册器在 `/:name` 旁挂载的每个字面段（至少 `drivers`），答 400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR 并点名保留段，与 `default` 同形。
查重: `datasource drivers name shadowed` 12 命中（无相关）、`reserved datasource name` 86（最近邻 #23634 #23768，宿主保留 `default`，已关）、`datasources drivers captured name` 52（最近邻 #27512，草稿探测文件，已关），含已关；无重复。
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-l2 — 10 cards from QA run #29151 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

QA-source: #29151 · integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
As admin on a stock showcase, `POST /api/v1/datasources {"name":"drivers","driver":"sqlite","config":{"filename":"/tmp/x/drivers.db"}}` answers 201 and `GET /api/v1/datasources` lists `drivers`. But `GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers` answers 200 `{data:{drivers:[…catalog…]}}`, not `{data:{datasource}}`. `PATCH` / `DELETE /datasources/drivers`, `POST /drivers/test`, `/drivers/migrate-credential` and `GET /api/v1/meta/datasource/drivers` all reach the row; only the detail read (the credential-stripped view the edit form uses, with `hasSecret` and `redactedConfigKeys`) cannot be served.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02); reproduced twice, with and without a secret.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; sign in as admin.
2. `POST /api/v1/datasources` with the body above → 201.
3. `GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers`.
4. **Expected:** the create refuses the reserved segment (as `default` is refused), or the detail read returns the datasource.
5. **Actual:** 201, then the driver catalog on the detail read.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
`assertValidName` (`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts:1350-1364`) reserves only `default`. The registrar mounts the static `GET ${root}/drivers` (`admin-routes.ts:695`) before `GET ${root}/:name` (:749), whose comment says the order exists "so that literal segment is never captured as a name"; the create door still mints the name.
